title: Two new L'Oréal brand / customer marketing roles + still-open favorites
intro: Quiet weekend overnight, then two New York L'Oréal openings I hadn't numbered yet (both verified live on careers.loreal.com this morning). Both are stretches. Your strongest LA leads (#20 and #3) are still open. None of today's new postings mentions travel to Paris.

sections.title: New today
sections.intro: Found / verified Oct 12. Both New York hybrid; Softsheen is the clearer brand-marketing fit.

sections.title: Still open (favorites)

notes: SMCP Group: still no US marketing/brand/partnerships — Greenhouse is NY corporate (AR, Allocation Planner, EA) + retail only.
#16 Assistant Manager, Social and Content (PPD DMI) returned 404 on careers.loreal.com today.
Pernod Ricard Manager, Senior Field Marketing (Los Angeles, posted today) is live but asks for 7+ years and ~$140–174k — too senior to number.

jobs.title: Manager, Marketing — Softsheen-Carson (US)
jobs.work_arrangement: Hybrid (3 days in office, 2 from home)
jobs.french_tie: L'Oréal (Paris HQ); Softsheen-Carson is in the Consumer Products Division. The posting partners with the global (DMI) team.
jobs.why: A real brand-marketing manager seat: you own go-to-market for Softsheen-Carson mascara launches, consumer insights, media/agency work, and P&L forecasting, and you partner with the global DMI team on product development. New York hybrid, not LA.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 3–6 years of CPG or beauty marketing plus operational launch experience — a reach from AE + college internships.

jobs.title: Customer Marketing Manager, Drug Channel (L'Oréal Dermatological Beauty)
jobs.french_tie: L'Oréal (Paris HQ); Dermatological Beauty division (CeraVe, La Roche-Posay, and related brands).
jobs.travel: Up to 20% for retailer meetings, trade shows, and conferences (US) — posting does not mention Paris
jobs.why: You'd run customer marketing plans for CVS and Walgreens (in-store events, displays, retailer programs) and work with brand marketing, media, and NAMs. Closest to trade / retailer partnership work — useful if you like the account side of marketing.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 3–5 years with mass-retail or drug-channel accounts in sales, marketing, or category management. More commerce/customer than brand building.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager, Global Brand Partnerships (NYX Professional Makeup)
jobs.french_tie: L'Oréal (Paris HQ); NYX's global brand partnerships team.
jobs.why: Still the strongest LA fit: partnerships with fandoms and communities, no minimum years listed.
